correctness.rationale: Each proposal candidate has two approval incidences. Strict improvement consumes at least one incidence, giving at most \(2|T|\) improving voters. The quota rules out blocking for \(2k<n\). At \(n=2k\), equality throughout the incidence count forces three consecutive vacancies for each member of a blocking T; the two voters adjoining a vacant center block conversely. Rooted gap vectors yield \(C_k=2[z^k](1+z+z^2)^k\). Local CLT and Stirling imply the asymptotic fraction. The included exhaustive exact-integer checker passes every directly enumerated coalition proposal for \(n=2k\)<=12 and \(2k<n\)<=9; this is corroboration rather than infinite proof.
